mapper.sql: a.id, a.title, a.description, a.class_id, c.class_term, cp.campus_name, a.course_id, crs.course_name, a.course_detail_id, cd.day_num as course_day_num, a.course_content_snapshot, a.homework_date, s.schedule_type, a.attachment_name, a.attachment_url, a.attachment_type, a.answer_attachment_name, a.answer_attachment_url, a.answer_attachment_type, a.answer_publish_status, a.answer_publish_time, a.answer_publish_teacher_id, coalesce(ans_u.real_name, ans_u.nickname, ans_u.username) as answer_publish_teacher_name, a.publish_teacher_id, coalesce(pub_u.real_name, pub_u.nickname, pub_u.username) as publish_teacher_name, a.publish_date, a.deadline, a.status, a.allow_resubmit, a.student_count_snapshot, ifnull(sub.submitted_count, 0) as submitted_count, a.deleted, a.close_time, a.close_teacher_id, coalesce(close_u.real_name, close_u.nickname, close_u.username) as close_teacher_name, a.create_time, a.update_time
mapper.insert: insert into homework_assignment ( title, description, class_id, homework_date, course_id, course_detail_id, course_content_snapshot, attachment_name, attachment_url, attachment_type, answer_attachment_name, answer_attachment_url, answer_attachment_type, answer_publish_status, answer_publish_time, answer_publish_teacher_id, publish_teacher_id, publish_date, deadline, status, allow_resubmit, student_count_snapshot, deleted, close_time, close_teacher_id, create_time, update_time ) values ( #{title}, #{description}, #{classId}, #{homeworkDate}, #{courseId}, #{courseDetailId}, #{courseContentSnapshot}, #{attachmentName}, #{attachmentUrl}, #{attachmentType}, #{answerAttachmentName}, #{answerAttachmentUrl}, #{answerAttachmentType}, #{answerPublishStatus}, #{answerPublishTime}, #{answerPublishTeacherId}, #{publishTeacherId}, #{publishDate}, #{deadline}, #{status}, #{allowResubmit}, #{studentCountSnapshot}, #{deleted}, #{closeTime}, #{closeTeacherId}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime} )
mapper.update: update homework_assignment set title = #{title}, description = #{description}, class_id = #{classId}, homework_date = #{homeworkDate}, course_id = #{courseId}, course_detail_id = #{courseDetailId}, course_content_snapshot = #{courseContentSnapshot}, attachment_name = #{attachmentName}, attachment_url = #{attachmentUrl}, attachment_type = #{attachmentType}, answer_attachment_name = #{answerAttachmentName}, answer_attachment_url = #{answerAttachmentUrl}, answer_attachment_type = #{answerAttachmentType}, answer_publish_status = #{answerPublishStatus}, answer_publish_time = #{answerPublishTime}, answer_publish_teacher_id = #{answerPublishTeacherId}, publish_teacher_id = #{publishTeacherId}, publish_date = #{publishDate}, deadline = #{deadline}, status = #{status}, allow_resubmit = #{allowResubmit}, student_count_snapshot = #{studentCountSnapshot}, deleted = #{deleted}, close_time = #{closeTime}, close_teacher_id = #{closeTeacherId}, update_time = #{updateTime} where id = #{id}
mapper.select: select from homework_assignment a left join edu_class c on c.id = a.class_id left join edu_campus cp on cp.id = c.campus_id left join edu_course crs on crs.id = a.course_id left join edu_course_detail cd on cd.id = a.course_detail_id left join edu_class_schedule s on s.class_id = a.class_id and s.schedule_date = a.homework_date left join sys_user pub_u on pub_u.id = a.publish_teacher_id left join sys_user ans_u on ans_u.id = a.answer_publish_teacher_id left join sys_user close_u on close_u.id = a.close_teacher_id left join ( select assignment_id, count(1) as submitted_count from homework_submission group by assignment_id ) sub on sub.assignment_id = a.id where a.id = #{id} and a.deleted = 0
mapper.update: update homework_assignment set deleted = 1, update_time = now() where id = #{id}
mapper.select: select a.id, a.title, a.description, crs.course_name as courseName, a.course_content_snapshot as courseContentSnapshot, a.homework_date as homeworkDate, a.publish_date as publishDate, a.deadline, a.status, a.allow_resubmit as allowResubmit, a.attachment_name as attachmentName, a.attachment_url as attachmentDownloadUrl, a.answer_publish_status as answerPublishStatus, case when a.answer_publish_status = 'PUBLISHED' then a.answer_attachment_name else null end as answerAttachmentName, case when a.answer_publish_status = 'PUBLISHED' then a.answer_attachment_url else null end as answerAttachmentDownloadUrl, sub.status as submissionStatus, sub.submit_content as submitContent, sub.attachment_name as submissionAttachmentName, sub.attachment_url as submissionAttachmentDownloadUrl, sub.submit_time as submitTime, sub.score, sub.teacher_comment as teacherComment, sub.version from homework_assignment a left join edu_course crs on crs.id = a.course_id left join homework_submission sub on sub.assignment_id = a.id and sub.student_no = #{studentNo} where a.deleted = 0 and a.class_id = #{classId} order by a.homework_date desc, a.publish_date desc, a.id desc

select a.id, a.title, a.description, a.class_id as classId, a.course_id as courseId, a.course_detail_id as courseDetailId, crs.course_name as courseName, cd.day_num as courseDayNum, a.course_content_snapshot as courseContentSnapshot, a.homework_date as homeworkDate, a.publish_date as publishDate, a.deadline, a.status, a.allow_resubmit as allowResubmit, a.attachment_name as attachmentName, a.attachment_url as attachmentUrl, a.attachment_url as attachmentDownloadUrl, a.attachment_type as attachmentType, a.answer_publish_status as answerPublishStatus, a.answer_publish_time as answerPublishTime, case when a.answer_publish_status = 'PUBLISHED' then a.answer_attachment_name else null end as answerAttachmentName, case when a.answer_publish_status = 'PUBLISHED' then a.answer_attachment_url else null end as answerAttachmentUrl, case when a.answer_publish_status = 'PUBLISHED' then a.answer_attachment_url else null end as answerAttachmentDownloadUrl, case when a.answer_publish_status = 'PUBLISHED' then a.answer_attachment_type else null end as answerAttachmentType, sub.status as submissionStatus, sub.submit_content as submitContent, sub.attachment_name as submissionAttachmentName, sub.attachment_url as submissionAttachmentUrl, sub.attachment_url as submissionAttachmentDownloadUrl, sub.attachment_type as submissionAttachmentType, sub.submit_time as submitTime, sub.score, sub.teacher_comment as teacherComment, sub.version from homework_assignment a left join edu_course crs on crs.id = a.course_id left join edu_course_detail cd on cd.id = a.course_detail_id left join homework_submission sub on sub.assignment_id = a.id and sub.student_no = #{studentNo} where a.deleted = 0 and a.id = #{id}
